in_use_evidence: Option A replaces TASK_DRAFT_INVALID text and code does the other side (field-code problems); option B replaces the field-code text that DefinitionStoreService and test_publication_routes.py do build, so in use there. Not in use under every option.

rule_gap: Option B (built) makes the text in use while option A does not; the rule 'in use under every option' settles it as not in use, but the harms_downstream answer then depends on which option the stakeholder picks.
